bathAction.title: Wash chest
bathAction.tooltip: Wash the chest, under it, and over the nipples.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(wash)] over [npc.her] [npc.breasts], under them where the sweat hides, and across [npc.her] [npc.nipples] with a careful hand. Water sheets off [npc.her] chest. [npc.She] [npc.verb(follow)] it with [npc.her] palm until the skin is clean. [npc.speech(Under them too. That is where it collects.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(take)] the weight of [npc.her] [npc.breasts] in both hands and [npc.verb(let)] hot water run between them and over [npc.her] [npc.nipples]. [npc.Her] breath catches. [npc.She] [npc.verb(let)] out [npc.a_moan+] and [npc.verb(linger)] on the next pass. [npc.speech(Do not rush this part. I can feel all of it.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(scrub)] [npc.her] chest, under [npc.her] [npc.breasts] and straight over [npc.her] [npc.nipples], then [npc.verb(rinse)] it off in one hard pass. [npc.She] [npc.verb(hiss)] at the friction and [npc.verb(keep)] going. [npc.speech(Enough. Rinse it off and leave them.)]
